hints.account: Your photo, name, username, email and password.
hints.privacy: Who can follow you, find you and see your friends.
hints.notifications: What reaches your phone, and what only shows here.
hints.appearance: Light, dark, or the same as your device.

install.title: Install Manteion
install.body: Open it from your home screen like any app, and get notifications there.

account.name: Name
account.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dots and underscores. People find you by it.
account.deleteBody: Deleting your account removes your profile, your events, leaflets and messages for good.
account.deleteConfirm: This can’t be undone. Enter your password to confirm.

privacy.lede: Who can follow you, find you and see who you know, and what chats show of you.

allow_public_follow.title: Anyone can follow you
allow_public_follow.description: When off, you approve each new follower first.

searchable.title: Let people find you by name
searchable.description: Your profile shows up when people search for someone to add.

show_friends_list.title: Show your friends on your profile
show_friends_list.description: Others can see who you are friends with.

appear_in_friends_lists.title: Appear in your friends’ lists
appear_in_friends_lists.description: Your name shows when someone looks at a friend’s friends.

share_typing.title: Show when you are typing
share_typing.description: People in the chat see that you are writing.

share_read_receipts.title: Show when you have read messages
share_read_receipts.description: Others see “Seen” under their message once you have read it. Off until you turn it on.

notifications.lede: Choose what reaches you, and where. Everything still shows up in Activity, and Manteion never sends marketing.

device.title: Notifications on this device
device.off: Off. Turn on to get notifications here.
device.blocked: Blocked in this browser. Allow notifications for this site in the browser’s settings.
device.failed: Couldn’t turn on notifications here. Try again.
device.testHint: Check that notifications reach this device.
device.testSent: Sent. It should arrive in a few seconds…
device.testMissing: No test arrived. Check that notifications for this browser are allowed in the device’s settings.
device.testFailed: Couldn’t send a test. Try again.
device.installTitle: Add Manteion to your Home Screen first
device.installBody: On iPhone and iPad, notifications work in the installed app. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open Manteion from there.
device.unsupported: This browser can’t get notifications from Manteion.
device.unconfigured: Notifications aren’t set up on this server yet.

notifications.defaultsNote: Messages are on by default. Turn on the rest only if you want them on your lock screen.

group_messages.title: Group messages
group_messages.description: New messages in your group chats

event_invites.title: Invitations
event_invites.description: When someone invites you to an event

event_comments.title: Comments on your events
event_comments.description: When someone comments on an event you host

followed_events.title: New events from people you follow

followers.title: New followers
followers.description: New followers and approved follow requests

leaflet_responses.title: Responses to your leaflets
leaflet_responses.description: When someone responds to a leaflet of yours

previews.title: Show message previews
previews.description: Show who wrote and what they said. When off, a notification only says “New message”.

devices.title: Devices that get notifications
devices.note: Removing a device stops notifications there right away.
devices.none: No devices yet. Turn on notifications on a phone or computer to see it here.
devices.removeBody: {device} stops getting notifications. You can turn them on there again at any time.

appearance.darkHint: Easy on the eyes in the evening
appearance.soundTitle: Play a sound for new messages
appearance.soundHint: A soft chime while Manteion is open
appearance.soundNote: This is saved in this browser only.

language.lede: The language Manteion speaks to you in, here and in notifications.
